{{c|corrupted|Corrupted}} {{c|gem|level 1 Summon Skeletons with 23% quality}} |recipe1_part1_item_name = The Skeleton |recipe1_part1_amount = 6 }} '''Summon Skeletons''' is a [[spell]] that summons allied skeleton warrior [[minion]]s. ==Skill Functions and Interactions== * {{il|Spell Totem Support}} - When Summon Skeletons is supported with Spell Totem Support, the totem will continue to cast Summon Skeletons even if the maximum number of skeletons has been reached. Older skeletons will then be replaced by newer skeletons, possibly switching target. * Summon Skeletons ''cannot'' be supported by {{il|Unleash Support|Unleash}} due to the fact that the skill can gain a cooldown from {{il|From Dust}}.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3230992/filter-account-type/staff * Regular and [[Perfect Judgemental Spirit|Perfect]] {{il|Judgemental Spirit}} [[spectre]]s grant added fire and chaos damage to allied skeleton attacks. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Skeletons
Summoned |c1_header = Summons x Skeleton Warriors |c1_pattern_extract = Summons (%d+) Skeleton Warriors |c1_pattern_value = %d |c2_abbr = Maximum
Skeletons |c2_header = Maximum x Summoned Skeletons |c2_pattern_extract = Maximum (%d+) Summoned Skeletons |c2_pattern_value = %d }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Skeleton limit== By default, the player can summon up to 5 skeletons at a given time. This limit can be increased with gem level, certain passive skills or items. ===Passive skills=== The following [[passive skills]] increase the player's skeleton limit: {{Query base passive skills |where=passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%skeleton%" }} ===Cluster Jewel passive skills=== The following [[Cluster Jewel]] passives are related to Skeletons: {{Passive skill table |q_where= passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%" AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%skeleton%" |large=1 |stat_text=1 }} ===Unique items=== The following [[unique items]] affect the player's skeleton limit: {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where=item_stats.id like "%base_number_of_skeletons%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ===Jun=== The following veiled modifiers change the cap of the summoned skeletons * {{ml|JunMasterVeiledMaximumZombieAndSkeleton|display=verbose}} ([[helmet]], unveiling only) * {{c|crafted|[[Modifier:JunMaster2MaximumZombieAndSkeleton1~|+1 to maximum number of Raised Zombies, +1 to maximum number of Skeletons]]}} (craftable on [[helmet]], or as a legacy mod in [[body armour]]) * {{c|crafted|[[Modifier:JunMasterMaximumZombieAndSkeleton1|+1 to maximum number of Raised Zombies, +1 to maximum number of Skeletons]]}} (on existing [[body armour]] or [[helmet]] in permanent leagues as legacy items: double legacy mod that only requires character level 1 to equip) ===Delve=== * {{ml|MaximumMinionCountSkeletonDelve|display=verbose}} ([[body armour]] or [[amulet]] only mod) can drop from the [[Azurite Mine]] node [[Beast Burrow]] that state {{c|mod|Contains Minion or Aura Items}}. The node has generic version which does not drop item with Delve-only mod. Fossil cannot roll this mod as outcome. ===Total=== Players can have a maximum of 15 (or more) Skeletons at once: *7 from level 20 skill gem (8 for level 25-38, up to 9 for level 39+ skill) *1 from 20% gem quality *2 from passive skills *2 from dual wielding {{il|Midnight Bargain}} *1 from [[veiled mod|unveiled]]/crafted prefix {{c|mod|Chosen}}/[[modifier:JunMaster2MaximumZombieAndSkeleton1~|{{c|crafted|Chosen}}]] on a helmet *1 from [[List of Delve modifiers|Delve]] drop-only body armour with prefix {{ml|MaximumMinionCountSkeletonDelve}}; or a legacy crafted prefix [[modifier:JunMaster2MaximumZombieAndSkeleton1~|{{c|crafted|Chosen}}]] on a body armour *1 from an [[Elder item|Elder]] amulet with [[List of amulet modifiers|prefix]] {{ml|MaximumSkeletonsUber1}} or Delve drop-only amulet with prefix {{ml|MaximumMinionCountAmuletSkeletonDelve__}} This does not take into account stacking more than 20% gem quality. Note that {{il|Alberon's Warpath}} no longer grants {{c|mod|+1 to Maximum number of Skeletons}}, but its [[legacy variant]]s may still be obtainable in permanent leagues. ==Threshold jewels== Legacy {{il|Dead Reckoning}} is the threshold jewel of Summon Skeletons. {{Skill enchantment modifier list| query = mods.id LIKE "%EnchantmentSummonSkeletons%" }} Due to [[version 3.0.0]] changes, the double legacy mod functions the same as the legacy mod, which both add {{C|enchanted|#% chance to Summon an additional Skeleton with Summon Skeletons}}. However, it uses stat id "summon_skeletons_additional_warrior_skeleton_one_twentieth_chance", which has a value of 1 or 2 depending on labyrinth difficulty. The legacy enchantments have different trade filters in the official trade website. ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Skeletons: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Skeleton%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Acton's_Nightmare%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%The_Princess%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ===Drop-disabled=== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Skeletons but can only be found in the permanent leagues: {{item table |where=items.rarity_id = "unique" AND items.stat_text LIKE "%Skeleton%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Acton's_Nightmare%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%The_Princess%" AND items.is_in_game = true AND items.drop_enabled = false |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} {{Alternate skill effect list|skill=Skeletons}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now provides +0-1 to Maximum Summoned Skeletons, instead of causing Minions to deal 0-20% increased Damage. * No longer has alternative quality. * Now has transfigured versions: [[Summon Skeletons of Archers]] and [[Summon Skeletons of Mages]]. }} {{Version history table row|3.20.0| * Quality on Divergent Summon Skeletons now provides "+0-1 seconds to Cooldown" and "Summons 0-4 Skeleton Warriors" (previously "Minions' Attacks have 0-10% chance to Maim Enemies on Hit"). }} {{Version history table row|3.19.0| * The damage and life scaling values for minions have been adjusted. Generally speaking, minion life and damage is unchanged in the very early game, roughly 30% lower in mid acts, roughly 20% lower at level 20 of the minion skill, and roughly 10% lower at level 30 of the minion skill. * No longer has Minions gain 50% more Added Damage. * Skeletal Mages now deal approximately 5% less damage at gem level 1, scaling to approximately 25% less damage at gem level 20. * Now costs 5 mana at gem level 1 (previously 4), up to 16 at gem level 20 (previously 12). }} {{Version history table row|3.14.0| * Modifiers that are unveiled through Jun are now more powerful than before. Previously, when an item was unveiled, the veiled modifier added to the item would be equal to the highest tier modifier available on the Crafting Bench. Now, the modifier being unveiled no longer counts as a crafted modifier and will be stronger than any craftable veiled modifier. }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| * Now has alternative quality. }} {{Version history table row|3.10.0| * Damage dealt by minions at all gem levels has been lowered by approximately 40%. This change isn't visible on the gem as it is a property of the minion itself, and does not affect Skeleton Mages or any other non-basic Skeleton minions summoned by Vaal Summon Skeletons. * The number of maximum summoned skeletons you can have at gem level 20 is now 7 (from 8). * The Veiled modifier that grants +1 to you maximum number of Summoned Skeletons and Raised Zombies can now only be unveiled/crafted on the helmet slot. It can no longer be unveiled/crafted on body armours. }} {{Version history table row|3.8.0| * Now summons 2 Skeleton Warriors per cast (from 1). * Now summons more Skeleton Warriors per cast as the gem levels up, up to 3 at gem level 20. * Now increases your maximum Skeleton limit as the gem levels up, up to 8 by gem level 20 (from 5). }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 13 (was 12). }} {{Version history table row|3.5.0| * The crafting mod was linked to [[Jun]] and Syndicate after master rework. }} {{Version history table row|3.1.0| * Summoned Skeletons now have a 50% more added damage multiplier, up from 30% less added damage. * {{il|Iron Will Support}} can now support Summon Skeleton and will affect the damage dealt by Skeleton Mages if you are using the {{il|Dead Reckoning}} threshold jewel. }} {{Version history table row|3.0.0| * Summon Skeletons has been renamed Summon Skeleton, and has been reworked. Many of the passives and items that interact with it have been rebalanced. Summon Skeleton now has a base cast time of 0.5 seconds, and the cost has been reduced by approximately 60% at all levels. It now summons a single skeleton per cast and has a base limit of 5 summoned skeletons. * The Summoned Skeleton Warrior minion's attack time has been reduced to 0.8 seconds, and its base damage has been increased by approximately 66%. Summoned Skeleton Mage minion's cast time has been reduced to 1.2 seconds. * Summoned Skeleton Mages now deal 50% more damage at gem level 20, and significantly more damage at earlier gem levels. Their behaviour has been tweaked and they will no longer flee. * Labyrinth helmet enchantments for Summon Skeleton now grant a 20/40% chance to summon an additional Skeleton minion. This applies to existing Labyrinth enchantments. * [[Catarina, Master of the Dead|Catarina]]'s [[Modifier:IntMasterMaximumSkeletonsCraftedUpdated|crafted mod]] now grants +1 maximum skeleton, down from +2 maximum skeletons. * Army of Bones: Renamed to To Dust. No longer grants +2 to Maximum number of Skeletons. In addition to reducing skeleton duration and increasing minion damage, it now grants 3-5% increased Skeleton Movement Speed, 7-10% increased Skeleton Attack Speed, and 7-10% increased Skeleton Cast speed. * Dead Reckoning now grants the ability to summon an additional 5 Skeleton Mages, up from 3, and is now limited to 3. * Queen's Decree: now grants +1 to maximum number of Skeletons, down from +2. * Alberon's Warpath: now grants +1 to maximum number of Skeletons, down from +2. * Midnight Bargain: now grants +1 to maximum number of Skeletons, down from +2. * Lord of the Dead now +1 skeleton, down from +2. * Herd the Flock no longer grants +1 skeleton. }} {{Version history table row|2.6.0| * Cast time reduced to 0.8 sec (down from 1 sec). * Mana cost reduced by about 30% at all levels. }} {{Version history table row|2.5.0| *Summon Skeletons skill now deal 25% more damage. Vaal Summon Skeletons skills now have a cast time of 0.8 seconds, down from 1 second. *Totems and all other minions now have 40% elemental resistance and 20% chaos resistance. This also includes minions that didn't have resistances previously, like wolves. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * No longer deals less elemental damage but now has a new stat which reduces Minions Added Damage by 50%. }} {{Version history table row|1.2.0| * Summoned Skeletons deal 50% more base damage than they did previously. }} {{Version history table row|1.0.6| * The mana cost of the Summon Skeletons skill has been reduced at all levels. * Summoned skeletons now do around 40% more damage at all levels. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.12| * Life increased by 50%. * Skeletons are now summoned in pairs, regardless of the level of the gem. * The maximum number of raisable skeletons now starts at 4 and goes up to 6 at maximum level.
An additional six can be obtained from the passive skill tree. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.7c| * Fixed the sound effects so that it isn't too loud when multiple skeletons are summoned. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.7| * Summon Skeletons has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
